text.en: Tamil has many sister languages, and linguists group them into one family.

This prose piece explains that Tamil is the senior language among the Dravidian languages and can meet the demands of every age and every kind of newness. Scholars of other countries who studied Tamil have praised its classical excellence (செம்மொழி). The lesson compares Tamil with other languages of the family.
It describes how, in early times, people shared thoughts through gestures, sounds and drawings, and slowly developed languages. The lesson helps us see where Tamil belongs among the world's languages.
Key terms: திராவிட மொழிக்குடும்பம் (Dravidian family), செம்மொழி (classical language), மொழி (language) and தொன்மை (antiquity). Learn the names of Dravidian languages such as Tamil, Telugu, Kannada and Malayalam.
